thread:
tess: FYI SI partner flagged that their managed clusters auto-updated to driver 540 and started hitting runtime allocation failures when switching between mixed NV/AMD node pools.
omar: Was that from marketplace image or their infra auto-update?
tess: They pulled marketplace/redwood:dedicated-2026-03-21 which we updated last night; marketplace bot shows driver-auto-roll enabled.
hannah: Any error snippets?
tess: From their logs: `RuntimeError: cudaMallocAsync failed during kv cache expansion` when job moves to NV node mid-run. AMD nodes running ROCm 5.8 unaffected.
omar: Looks like we need to avoid mixed-driver rollouts. Immediate mitigation: marketplace should publish a driver-stable tag that pins NV to 535 until we verify 540.
marketplace-bot: action: publish tag redwood/dedicated-2026-03-21-pin-535 by hannah (hold auto-roll).
amd-eng: We'll notify SI integrators not to mix node pools while driver investigations are ongoing.
si-integration: Thanks 1 feeling better now that the pin is out, please share rollback steps for managed clusters.
hannah: Sending rollback snippet and brief partner note now.
